caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a green dress with a full skirt, fitted bodice, and three-quarter length sleeves. The dress is predominantly medium green, with decorative elements in lighter green and white. It has a peplum waistline and is trimmed with gathered ruffles along the edges of the sleeves, bodice, and the front closure. The skirt is adorned with bands of green and white patterns, floral embroidery, and motifs, and has a wide ruffled hem at the bottom in a deeper green shade with white accent stripes. The sleeves have bows or gathered decorations near the elbows. Above and to the left of the main colored illustration, there is a smaller, uncolored line drawing of the same dress, showing the back view with lace and bow details at the lower edge and cuffs, as well as a slightly flared skirt with similar decorative trim. The background is a plain beige color with no additional objects or patterns.
title: Dress
